meta.act: ACT FOUR · THE BLIP, TOLD TWICE
meta.note: Planned lengths are starting points (flow-and-continuity: guidelines, not gates). lock_v4.py sets the frames.

sequences.title: NOON, LAS VEGAS: THE PLAN AND THE CALL
sequences.place: the Vegas suite, Nov 17 at noon; THE PLAN and the call inside his laptop
sequences.question: What does this board want with him?
sequences.turn: Cancel; "You've been removed from the meeting."; "super."
sequences.cue: MM-07 (felt bar -> WORD -> the waltz -> PLAN -> BREAK, tape-stop to zero on JOIN) then MM-08 LEVERAGE, one take from the connect to Cancel; stop 1 = D6
sequences.bed: the suite (HVAC, the Strip, the truck) ~-38 dBFS; ~-40 under THE PLAN

sequences.title: THAT NIGHT: THE THIRD MARK
sequences.question: Has this happened before? How does he take it?
sequences.turn: the Orb counts three marks, then rewinds
sequences.cue: MM-08 26A: the felt's open fifth on the first stroke (the re-entry after D6); pedal only under TPOOL; the Rewind lands on S3's downbeat
sequences.bed: the dark room -38..-40, pre-lapped 1 s under S1.12; TPOOL frosted office -40 crossfaded on the fronts

sequences.title: FRIDAY, THE BOARD'S SIDE: STEPS ONE TO THREE
sequences.place: Neleh's desk, Nov 17 noon into night; one bridged trip to the all-hands
sequences.question: They've done it. Can they run it?
sequences.turn: steps 1-3 done, Gerg gone, "coup" owned; by night Mas answers in public
sequences.cue: MM-09 a (NOON) -> a's night bars, one performance with S4; no stop; thins under the posts and the real lines
sequences.bed: Neleh's office -40 (day and night); the all-hands crowd -36

sequences.title: THE WEEKEND, THE BOARDROOM: STEP FOUR
sequences.place: the boardroom, Nov 18 night to Nov 19 at 11:53 PM
sequences.question: What's step four?
sequences.turn: Macrosoft's door opens with Mas's name on the sign; Mada has no answer
sequences.cue: MM-09 b -> c -> d (LIGHTHOUSE, both calls) -> e -> f -> g -> h: the pizzicato slows and hangs on one held note under "Step four?" and Mada
sequences.bed: the boardroom -38..-40; the split: boardroom air left, lighthouse wind right; the lobby camera's hum -40

sequences.chapter: HIS SIDE · what they didn't know
sequences.title: HIS SIDE, 2 AM: WHAT THEY DIDN'T KNOW
sequences.place: his dark room, Nov 20 at about 2 AM
sequences.question: Does he have anything left?
sequences.turn: every card: the staff, Alyi, the money, Gerg, the open door
sequences.cue: 09x REVERSAL on the card -> its F4 rings into MM-10 a (the DARK ROOM pedal); the Build first with Gerg's tile; stop 2 on Gerg's glance

sequences.chapter: HIS SIDE · what they didn't know
sequences.title: THE AVALANCHE
sequences.place: his monitor, showing the board's call from his side
sequences.question: How does the board fall?
sequences.cue: MM-10 b re-rendered to the avalanche's length, each phrase whole; dead stop on MADA's label (stop 3)

sequences.chapter: HIS SIDE · what they didn't know
sequences.title: THE RETURN: MONDAY AT HQ, TUESDAY IN THE BOARDROOM
sequences.place: NopeAI HQ: the bullpen Mon Nov 20, then the boardroom Tue Nov 21 ~10 PM
sequences.question: Will they take him back, and on whose terms?
sequences.turn: "Good question."; the terms say CEO; Gerg is back; the clock runs out
sequences.cue: the STRAIGHT violin (holds and decays under the hearts) -> Tasya's Rhodes pad on "below" -> MM-11 c1 fades in under S7.05 (the bang inside it) -> out on "Terms?" (stop 4) -> c2's C pedal under the stamp -> the Build
sequences.bed: the bullpen by day -38..-40; the boardroom with fires, crackle ~-36

sequences.chapter: HIS SIDE · the lobby and after
sequences.title: THE LOBBY, AND AFTER
sequences.place: the lobby that night, then the bullpen's back wall, Nov 22 to Nov 29
sequences.question: Is he safe now? What did it cost?
sequences.turn: "okay."; Alyi's plate comes off; Macrosoft gets a chair with no vote
sequences.cue: VICTORY LAP: brass stab on the sign -> chip note -> the 1993 flat line as one tenuto -> bonk (SFX) -> neon buzz quiet -> "okay." -> felt cadence onto the vault's F hum -> into the tag
sequences.bed: the lobby at night -40, pre-lapped under the shatter; the bullpen by day -40 under the coda
